_comment: Run 1 test lines (mist-model-host plan v2). Invented text, no personal data. Each line names the feeling it should carry; `emotive` marks the lines whose feeling is not neutral, list, figures or long, which `original` also renders in its `expressive` setting. `turbo_text` is what the Turbo engine receives instead of `text`: its paralinguistic tags are its only emotion control. The acknowledgements are timed and rendered for listening but kept out of the 5-to-25-word statistics.

lines.text: Your timer is set for ten minutes, and I'll let you know when it's done.
It's eleven degrees outside right now, with light rain expected after six.
It's nearly two in the morning, boss. Save it and finish this tomorrow.
lines.turbo_text: [sigh] It's nearly two in the morning, boss. Save it and finish this tomorrow.

lines.text: Long day, wasn't it? I've set your alarm for eight. Get some sleep.
lines.turbo_text: [sigh] Long day, wasn't it? I've set your alarm for eight. Get some sleep.

lines.text: Evening. Good to have you back. What are we working on tonight?
Done. All four lights are off, which is a personal best for this room.
You asked me that yesterday too. Same answer: the blue one.
lines.turbo_text: You asked me that yesterday too. [chuckle] Same answer: the blue one.

lines.text: Careful there. Nobody actually has that number; what we have is an estimate.
Your train leaves in twelve minutes. If you go now, you'll make it.
Sorry, I lost the connection to the lights. Give me a second to try again.
That's the new speaker, is it? What do you want it doing?
That's the third test passing in a row. Nice work, honestly.
Nothing's broken. The backup finished at four, and every file checked out.
Headphones, charger, passport and the blue notebook. That's everything on your list.
The survey says sixty-three point eight percent, from about two thousand people in September.
I've moved your dentist appointment to Thursday at half past three, and I'll remind you an hour before, so don't worry about it.
That's a shame. I know you were looking forward to it.
No, I'm not ordering pizza again. You told me to stop you, remember?
Give me a moment. I'm pulling the numbers from last week now.
Alright, I'll go quiet. Shout if you need me.
